newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles council freezes $200 mln transit funds.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles council freezes $200 mln transit funds.

text.p: The Los Angeles City Council has voted to freeze $200 million in contributions to the county Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) because of proposed delays to a subway construction project, according to a newspaper report on Wednesday.

The Los Angeles Times reported that the city council voted 9-to-2 to freeze the funding until an agreement is reached with the city that would move forward the start of construction of the rail line across the San Fernando Valley.
City and MTA officials were expected to begin negotiations immediately to resolve the dispute.
